If you can only shadow for notes, say so.

Plan I'm proposing:
1) Laura / Marcus — primary backfill candidates for Wed 10:30 and Thu 11:00 respectively.
2) Monica — shadow for Thu 15:00 and own candidate notes capture.
3) Priyom — on-call fallback for any last-minute gaps and to take the panel quickguide/doc ownership.

Attachments: candidate resume + panel_quickguide_v2.pdf + calendar invite (I've updated tentative calendar and attached).

Please reply in-line with the slot you can own ASAP (copying Elena so she sees we have a recovery plan).
